dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains all of the stormwater fittings. These fittings connects two storm pipes together, due to a repair, to allow for a change in direction, to allow for a change in pipe diameter, to split the fluid flow, or to cover the end of a pipe.

Please be advised that these records are based upon available information, compiled from a variety of sources, some of which has not been verified. This is not a plan of survey, field verification is recommended.
